intent.proves: At least one active reward has an active reward rule.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomLoyaltyReward r WHERE r.LoyaltyRewardActive = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomLoyaltyRewardRule x WHERE x.LoyaltyRewardRuleRewardId = r.LoyaltyRewardId AND x.LoyaltyRewardRuleActive = 1)

sources.ref: DW10 database schema (INFORMATION_SCHEMA of a local DW10 install) and Dynamicweb.Ecommerce 10.29.8
